title: Warranty capture and a member code
description: Three capture services, each at its own partner address. On scan of an item in the named item groups, before its line goes on the sale, the service answers with a warranty reference for the line, as a value of a line attribute the shop keeps (the shop names it in the service's settings). On customer add, before the customer is created, the service refuses a customer without a mobile number or with a barred one, and otherwise sends the customer a one-time code: the till shows a code field, and the customer is created only after the right code (three wrong codes end it; an offline sale's customer and the receipt's contact after payment are created and flagged instead). On a quantity change of a line in the iPad group (POS build 2.0.0.654 on; a serial- or lot-tracked line, such as a phone sold by its IMEI, is never asked), up to three on a line are allowed, four or five asked about, more refused; a refusal puts the last allowed quantity back. No answer writes a customer field or moves money. All three install switched off; the shop reads what each is sent, ticks the consent and switches them on. When the service is down a scan goes on, flagged, and a new customer waits. The item groups and allowed_urls are the programme bench's; a partner writes its own.
